concept_table.Criterion: Fit to our profile (Huertas et al.)

design_evaluation.concept_verdict: Keep flow-through. U-shaped saves only ~9% put-away travel (~11 reach-truck minutes/day) because slow C items still bring 46% of inbound loads and picking travel is identical; its door saving depends on all inbound arriving before noon, which sea containers cannot guarantee. Flow-through keeps inbound, returns and outbound apart and fits the side-wall dock lengths.
